SPORTY, REFINED AND LOADED WITH TECH // All Durango trim levels flex a race-inspired cockpit with styling cues borrowed from the Dodge Challenger. The
sleek dash leans in toward the driver for ergonomic comfort, while the instrument panel showcases a 7-inch Thin Film Transistor (TFT) cluster design with full-color
graphics. The available flat-bottom steering wheel takes its performance feel to the next level with available paddle shifters. The standard Uconnect® 4 includes an
8.4-inch touchscreen, while the available Uconnect 5 radio features a 10.1-inch touchscreen display. An integrated control switch bank adds quick access to available
heated front seats and heated steering wheel controls. Having multiple devices that require different types of charging cords isn’t a problem. The center console houses
an auxiliary input and two sets of USB connections (Type-A/-C pairs). Need more? Opt for a second-row console that also has Type-A and Type-C USB ports.
Durango SRT® shown with available Laguna leather trim in Black and Demonic Red.

Standard 4-wheel antilock disc brakes provide
solid stopping power. Additional stopping power
comes from the available Brembo® Performance

rotors and four-piston front calipers for
outstanding heat management and that provide
superior braking performance. For superb
stopping capabilities, the SRT® engineered
Brembo Performance Brake System, with six-
piston front and four-piston rear calipers, results
in improved performance braking when paired
with wind-tunnel-designed brake ducts.

DDU22US4_012
A L L - W H E E L D R I V E
CONFIDENCE WHEN IT COUNTS // Wherever you go,
whatever the weather, Durango is ready to tackle the elements.
Durango offers three All-Wheel-Drive (AWD) Systems — a two-
speed, active on-demand system available on the 5.7L HEMI®
V8 engine; a single-speed, full-time system standard with
both the 5.7L HEMI V8 and 3.6L Pentastar® V6 engines; and the
Quadra-Trac® Active On-Demand System that adds the following
Drive Modes: Sport, Track, Tow and Snow. The standard AWD
System leverages the SUV’s near-perfect 50/50 weight
distribution to enhance traction and handling. The result is a
smooth driving experience over a wide range of road conditions.
DURANGO GT AWD //
shown in White Knuckle with Gunmetal
Low-Gloss dual graphic stripes.
